27:45.text: And indeed We sent to Thamûd their brother Sâlih, saying: "Worship Allâh
. Then look! They became two parties

27:46.text: He said: "O my people! Why do you seek to hasten the evil
? Why seek you not the Forgiveness of Allâh, that you may receive mercy?"

27:47.text: They said: "We augur ill omen from you and those with you." He said: "Your ill omen is with Allâh; nay, but you are a people that are being tested."

27:48.text: And there were in the city nine men
, who made mischief in the land, and would not reform.

27:49.text: They said: "Swear one to another by Allâh that we shall make a secret night attack on him and his household, and thereafter we will surely say to his near relatives: ‘We witnessed not the destruction of his household, and verily we are telling the truth.’"

27:50.text: So they plotted a plot, and We plotted a plot, while they perceived not.

27:51.text: Then see how was the end of their plot! Verily! We destroyed them and their nation, all together.

27:52.text: These are their houses in utter ruin, for they did wrong. Verily, in this is indeed an Ayâh

27:53.text: And We saved those who believed, and used to fear Allâh, and keep their duty to Him.

27:54.text: ! When he said to his people.
(evil, great sin, every kind of unlawful sexual intercourse, sodomy)
(one another doing evil without any screen)

27:55.text: "Do you practise your lusts on men instead of women? Nay, but you are a people who behave senselessly."
